notes.title: Update for Day Night System
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/9253810b0875406247bffb6eaaecd3ef735e947d.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/239919a2a8974c1f70a77144882418ff45e3a7c7.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/14e70aeea35d6f2f58939ed9ab8ae62441da99cc.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/851c2cb65d7cce0d11ba5feb6d8df7c03b3e1a5a.jpg

Right now, there are daytime, dusk and night time in this game. Time will gone while doing nothing and anything in Single player mode.  
Before this update，there is only daytime with sunshine. Player can only past a day by sleep.

 I think now would better than before. At the same time, I think it is the time for my game to change EA state as formal published. I started to make a new game ieda too. Thanks everyone who supported me.

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode is now available, in 3/3/2018 Big Update
notes.notes:
I am happy to tell everyone that Multiplayer mode in my game is available now.
Everyone who own my game can update this content for free.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/f58fccf325a5cacb20eea70c30e8cb30c2d306a2.png

Map in Multiplayer mode is about 7 time bigger than the map in Single player mode, its land area is about 4000M*4000M as a island. It is more beautiful than single player mode.

it support more than 10 people playing together, player can  act Escape Expert or Police. 

Its gameplay is also new, something like Battle Royale with Escape Expert type.

Please try to play it, then welcome to give me feedback, I will keep improving my game.

notes.title: Big update about AI, update in 15/12/2017
notes.notes:
Today, I optimized the behaviours of AI. I know the AI is really bad before, but now it become better.
1. It will avoid the wall and won't hit the wall when turning a corner. 
2. Police AI will start to arrest you after you do something to him. then you will have to help yourself to escape out of this town as a new work. 
3. Add some new Achievement such as NO ZUO NO DIE.

notes.title: Early Access Version is now available today with very low price， and about the first update patch
notes.notes:
Early Access Version is now available today with very low price

I also have some players report that the resources are consuming too fast, so I change the balance immediately, but I have to say that this is one of the feastures of this game, it have to be a constraint. The first mission is also very difficult because I want players fail in the begining work, just let you know what is the game look like at the begining.

Another problem is the Space button has a BUG, I fixed that in a new version now

This game may be a little bit too difficult to new player, but it is fun for me, so I am going to make a difficulty option in the feature

notes.title: About game development progress, release time and the very begining version
notes.notes:
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/d35f0f46f22b6dc691d82e4301eae1ab29410efe.png

When will this game release?
About my game “Escape Expert”, now the main design contents were done without BUG, it can be played now. In my original plan, I want to release it today (2/12/2017), because I can't wait to  share my game idea.

However, there are still many unperfect things, such as UI tips, new player tutorial, balance and lack ot mission amount. Although it is Early Access version now, players always want to provide negative comments, which I don't want it. So I want to use one more week to improve my game before release it.

I have statistics that there are many people visited my game store page, though the game hasn't released. The more player expect it, the more duty and more pressure I have.

Why develop this game? How it look like at the begining version?

At the begining, four months age, I was studying in UTS in Australia Sydney. It is my last semester, I was doing game designing and programing. Making a 3D game with some topic is my assignment. I chose touch screen and mobile platform as my topic, then made this game's begining version as my assignment. After that, I have more ideas about this game, and I am interested to continue to develop it individually. 
the image below is the very begining version in developing look like
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/6201c1efb646b28ceb8fdfa976942deed08cf01a.jpg

I found that, mobile phone is no longer enough to support this 3D game, so I develop it only for PC now. After that, I found that if I have no any income, I can't make it in long-term development, even though I really like it, so I chose Steam to publish my game. After that again, I found two friends for help in part-time, one of them can make models for me. We all are unprofessional, no any income now, but we are very enjoying to develop this game. 

Now the game is like the following screenshot
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/d35f0f46f22b6dc691d82e4301eae1ab29410efe.png
